overviewHtml:
Reliability test results usually live in a separate tool from your monitoring data. This app brings Gremlin's data into Dynatrace, so you see what is resilient and where the risk is.

Resilience testing tends to live in its own tool and its own report, which means nobody looks at it between incidents. Surfacing the reliability score on the service you are already watching makes it part of normal operations, and the dependency maps expose failure paths you cannot see from a single service view.

What you get

  • Gremlin failure test results
  • Mapped service dependencies
  • Reliability score for every service
  • Resilience and risk shown next to the metrics and services you already watch
setupHtml:
Gremlin Reliability Management is available as a Dynatrace app to all customers upon request.

  1. Gremlin Reliability Management is delivered via a Hub subscription. Email community-apps@dynatrace.com with your account name and tenant ID, as described here.
  2. We'll process your request and send instructions for subscribing to the channel and installing the app.
getStartedHtml:
1. Request the Hub subscription by emailing the community apps team
  2. Install the app once you receive the instructions
